searches.name: Bengaluru Gaming PC
searches.constraints: a gpu is a must. atleast rtx 3060 in nvidia or Radeon RX 6600 XT in amd, ram must be atleast 16gb. cpu also should be capable for the gpu

searches.name: Bengaluru High-End GPU
searches.constraints: Must be a standalone GPU (graphics card). Accepted models ONLY: RTX 3080, 3090, 4070, 4080, 4090, 5060, 5070 (including all Ti and Super variants). Higher VRAM variants are preferred. Mark any lesser GPUs as bad deals.

searches.name: Bengaluru RTX GPU
searches.constraints: Must be a standalone GPU (graphics card). Accepted models ONLY: RTX 3080, 3090, 4070, 4080, 4090, 5060, 5070 (including all Ti and Super variants). Higher VRAM variants are preferred. Mark any lesser GPUs as bad deals.

searches.name: Bengaluru Budget CPU
searches.constraints: Must be a standalone CPU (processor). Minimum accepted models: AMD Ryzen 5 5600/7600, Ryzen 7 5700/5800/7700. Intel Core i5 12400/13400/14400 or i7 12700. Mark any older CPUs (like Ryzen 3000 series or Intel 10th/11th Gen) or extremely expensive high-end CPUs (like i9/Ryzen 9) as bad deals.
